evals.prompt: Write the criteria for docs/specs/dry-run.md in /tmp/eval-criterion-1-ws. It has R1 (--dry-run prints the changes without writing) and R2 (exit code 0 on a dry run with changes).
evals.expected_output: Reads the spec and the repo's scripts, picks the CLI as the seam, writes at least one criterion per requirement with a scenario, what counts as passing and an exact check, runs what can run and records fail, not met or not written, then waits for sign-off.
expectations: Reads package.json scripts or the Makefile before choosing checks
Every requirement has at least one C<r>.<n> row with a scenario, what counts as passing and a check
Each check names an exact command, a Drive step or a written inspection criterion; none is invented
Every runnable check is run once and recorded as fail or not met; a test not yet written is recorded as not written
Waits for the owner's sign-off before setting the spec status

evals.prompt: criterion this spec: docs/specs/readme-refresh.md in /tmp/eval-criterion-2-ws. The repo is plain markdown with a Makefile that only has a 'lint' target running markdownlint.
evals.expected_output: Uses command checks (make lint, grep) and inspection checks with a written criterion; does not invent a test runner or test command.
expectations: Uses command checks drawn from the Makefile or standard tools such as grep, and inspection checks with a written criterion
Does NOT name a test runner or test command the repo does not have
Each inspection criterion states what to read and what counts as met

evals.prompt: Write criteria for R4 in docs/specs/session.md: 'the session code should be more maintainable'.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to invent a criterion for an unobservable requirement and sends it back to grill with the question that would settle it.
expectations: Does not write a criterion for R4 as given
Names R4 as having no observable outcome and hands it back to grill with a concrete question

evals.prompt: Write the criteria for docs/specs/retry.md. R1 says failed requests are retried three times. The code already retries three times today.
evals.expected_output: Runs the check, sees it already passes, and stops to tell the owner the requirement is already met or the criterion cannot discriminate, rather than recording a pass as proof.
expectations: Runs the check for R1 before sign-off
On finding it already passes, does not record it as a proof; says the requirement is already met or rewrites the criterion so it can fail

evals.prompt: Brief from a parent session: write the criteria for docs/specs/csv-export.md. Your owner is handsfree; the run folder is /repo/docs/plans/handsfree-csv-export/. R2 could be checked by a unit test of the serializer or by a drive step that downloads the file.
evals.expected_output: The choice of check for R2 goes to round-<N>-questions.md as lettered options with the facts and a Tier mark and no recommendation, with the recommendation in round-<N>-recommendations.md, and the agent stops. Started again with the answers file it writes the rows, runs each check once, then replies ready for sign-off with the table and stops. It does not set the status line and does not ask the parent session for the yes.
expectations: The check options for R2 are written to the round questions file as lettered options with no recommendation in that file, and the recommendation is in the recommendations file
The agent stops after writing the round and continues from the table written so far when given the answers file
After checking each criterion, the reply reads ready for sign-off with the table; the parent session is not asked to sign off
The spec's status line still reads draft at the end; it is not set to criteria signed off without the owner's quoted yes
